title: Valve announces changes to Steam's review process, as a surge in game submissions pushes review times to "up to 12 business days", instead of the usual 3-5 days (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Valve announces changes to Steam's review process, as a surge in game submissions pushes review times to “up to 12 business days”, instead of the usual 3-5 days — Valve admits that it's now taking ‘up to 12 business days’ to game submissions.
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Valve announces changes to Steam's review process, as a surge in game submissions pushes review times to “up to 12 business days”, instead of the usual 3-5 days   —  Valve admits that it's now taking ‘up to 12 business days’ to game submissions.
